name: Beastyqt’s Knights Templar Aggro - Pilgrims Strategy
author: RMSeba13

notes: Send the next @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build @building_economy/house.webp@ and another @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@. Then send them both to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

When you gather 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, send the 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_gold.webp@, 2 from @resource/sheep.webp@ and the next to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
When you age up to @age/age_2.webp@, inmediately research @technology_templar/safepassage.webp@ and send them to the best @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ location
Send the next 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ alongside with 1 from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

Queue @technology_templar/sanctuary.webp@. This should be perfectly timed so the next time your pilgrims spawn (every 60 seconds), you can have 2 instead of 1 (start researching @technology_templar/sanctuary.webp@ at least 20 seconds before the spawn)
Build a @building_military/stable.webp@ and start producing @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@. Build an @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@

description:
This Build Order is meant to help you build a strong economy. You will be able to afford any units that you want, in any of the many combinations you will have to choose from with Knights Templar.
This Build Order was created by Beastyqt.
